name.en: Ballasted ground fixed-tilt table (concrete ballast, no penetration)
name.es: Mesa fija de tilt lastrada en suelo (lastre de hormigón, sin penetración)

description.en: Fixed-tilt ground table that rests on precast concrete ballast blocks instead of driven or screwed foundations. Posts and anchor rods are preassembled in the ballast; a raised purlin or composite rail carries the modules. Block size, mass and concrete strength are not stated in the sources reviewed.
description.es: Mesa fija de tilt en suelo que apoya sobre bloques de lastre de hormigón prefabricados en lugar de cimentaciones hincadas o atornilladas. Postes y varillas de anclaje vienen preensamblados en el lastre; una correa elevada o un carril compuesto soporta los módulos. Tamaño, masa y resistencia del hormigón no se indican en las fuentes revisadas.

typical_use: Sites where penetrating the ground is restricted (contaminated soil, shallow rock, buried services, landfill caps).
applicable_standards: ASTM C1884 (concrete ballast block specification; listed by search, not reviewed, reference only)

materials.material: Concrete with fibre mesh instead of rebar (per source); class not stated
